title: Constraining the Commit Boundary: A DIO/ODI-Informed Authorization Guardrail for Agentic Entity Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.37407v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic Entity Resolution (ER) systems iteratively plan actions, retrieve evidence, revise hypotheses, and propose graph mutations. An erroneous identity hypothesis may condition later retrieval and produce apparent confirmation. This paper proposes a Digital Identity Optimization (DIO) and Ontology of Digital Identity (ODI)-informed authorization boundary between evidence available for agent reasoning and evidence eligible to authorize persistent identity-changing mutations.   A domain-governed constraint-binding function maps selected reconstruction-failure distinctions to explicit identity-preserving constraints. An abstract two-phase supervisor permits a commit only when claim-specific authorization-eligible evidence supports every required proposition, relevant conflicts are resolved, the operation remains within its authorized scope, and relevant state and policy versions remain valid. Admission as UNVERIFIED does not confer author

translated_title: 约束提交边界：一种基于DIO/ODI的智能体实体消解授权护栏
translated_abstract: 智能体实体消解（ER）系统会迭代地规划动作、检索证据、修正假设并提出图变更操作。一个错误的身份假设可能会影响后续检索，并产生表面上的确认。本文提出了一种受数字身份优化（DIO）和数字身份本体（ODI）启发的授权边界，用以区分可用于智能体推理的证据与有资格授权持久性身份变更操作的证据。一个由领域治理的约束绑定函数将选定的重构失败区别映射为显式的身份保护约束。一个抽象的两阶段监督器只有在以下条件全部满足时才允许提交：针对特定声明的授权合格证据支持每一项必需的命题、相关冲突已得到解决、操作保持在其授权范围内，并且相关的状态与策略版本仍然有效。被接纳为UNVERIFIED（未验证）状态并不赋予……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于DIO/ODI的授权护栏，将智能体推理可用的证据与可授权持久性身份变更的证据分离，并通过两阶段监督器仅在授权合格证据充分支持所有必需命题、冲突已解决且授权范围与策略版本有效时才允许提交身份变更，从而防止错误身份假设在智能体系统中自我确认。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a DIO/ODI-informed authorization guardrail that separates evidence available for agent reasoning from evidence eligible to authorize persistent identity-changing mutations, using a two-phase supervisor that permits commits only when claim-specific authorization-eligible evidence supports all required propositions, conflicts are resolved, and the operation remains within valid authorized scope and policy versions.
